note.zh-TW: T11 回覆後再定主要顯示。現行 IAS 7 允許列營業或籌資，教材列營業；IFRS 18 修正 IAS 7 後一般企業改列籌資活動。
note.en: The main display will be settled after T11. Current IAS 7 allows operating or financing and the course uses operating; after the IFRS 18 amendments most entities will classify it as financing.

definition.zh-TW: 本期實際付出去的利息現金。它和損益表的利息費用不同：費用是本期發生的，這裡是真的付了錢。
definition.en: The interest actually paid in cash during the period. It differs from interest expense on the income statement: the expense is what accrued, this line is what was paid.
